title: Settlement Options Schedule for Live Pet Health Guarantee Claims
content:
The remedies Tailwise Pet Co. gives on an accepted Live Pet Health Guarantee claim, and the terms attached to each, differ by guarantee type as follows.

### Remedies available on an accepted claim

| Guarantee type | Replacement | Store credit | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|
| Freshwater Fish Guarantee | available | available | not available |
| Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate Guarantee | available | available | not available |
| Live Coral Guarantee | not available | available | not available |
| Small Animal Guarantee | available | not available | available |
| Bird Guarantee | available | not available | available |
| Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee | available | not available | available |

### Terms of each remedy

| Guarantee type | Replacement must be the same species | A higher-priced replacement may be taken by paying the difference | Replacement collected within (calendar days after the claim) | Store credit usable for (calendar days) | Refund needs the original purchase record |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Freshwater Fish Guarantee | No | Yes | 30 | 365 | Yes |
| Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate Guarantee | No | Yes | 30 | 365 | Yes |
| Live Coral Guarantee | No | No | 30 | 365 | Yes |
| Small Animal Guarantee | Yes | Yes | 30 | 365 | Yes |
| Bird Guarantee | Yes | Yes | 30 | 365 | Yes |
| Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee | Yes | Yes | 30 | 365 | Yes |

### Restocking advice after a claim

| Guarantee type | Days the customer is asked to wait before restocking the tank |
|---|---|
| Freshwater Fish Guarantee | 7 |
| Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate Guarantee | 14 |
| Live Coral Guarantee | 14 |
| Small Animal Guarantee | 0 |
| Bird Guarantee | 0 |
| Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee | 0 |

### Points of judgement on the schedule

- A Live Coral Guarantee claim is settled in store credit only, since no other remedy is available for that type.
- No aquatic guarantee type offers a refund, and no small animal, bird or reptile and amphibian type offers store credit as a claim remedy.
- Under the Small Animal, Bird and Reptile & Amphibian Guarantees a replacement must be the same species as the animal claimed; under the Freshwater Fish and Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate Guarantees it need not be.
- Hypothetical illustration: under a Freshwater Fish Guarantee, a customer who prefers a replacement priced above the claimed fish may take it by paying the difference; under a Live Coral Guarantee there is no such option.
- Replacement window, hypothetical dates: for a claim accepted on 1 May, collection on 20 May (19 days after the claim) is within the 30-day window; collection on 10 June (40 days after the claim) is not.
